changeSet.author: kabipay-dev
changeSet.sql:
ALTER TABLE kabipay_ops.organization_company ADD COLUMN installed_version BIGINT, ADD COLUMN installed_hash VARCHAR(64), ADD COLUMN runtime_status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNINSTALLED' CHECK(runtime_status IN ('UNINSTALLED','ACTIVE','SUSPENDED','DETACHED'));
ALTER TABLE kabipay_ops.employment_ref ADD COLUMN source_user_id UUID; ALTER TABLE kabipay_ops.employment_ref ADD COLUMN department_id UUID; ALTER TABLE kabipay_ops.employment_ref ADD COLUMN designation_id UUID; ALTER TABLE kabipay_ops.employment_ref ADD COLUMN employee_code VARCHAR(100); ALTER TABLE kabipay_ops.employment_ref ADD COLUMN legacy_manager_employee_id UUID; ALTER TABLE kabipay_ops.employment_ref ADD CONSTRAINT uq_employment_org_id UNIQUE(organization_id,id); CREATE INDEX idx_employment_source_login ON kabipay_ops.employment_ref(source_tenant_id,source_user_id) WHERE source_user_id IS NOT NULL; CREATE TABLE kabipay_ops.organization_graph ( organization_id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES kabipay_ops.organization(id), version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(version>0) ); CREATE TABLE kabipay_ops.organization_directory_sync ( membership_id UUID PRIMARY KEY, organization_id UUID NOT NULL, membership_version BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK(membership_version>0), run_id UUID NOT NULL, source_after UUID, status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('RUNNING','COMPLETE')), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,membership_id) REFERENCES kabipay_ops.organization_company(organization_id,id) ); CREATE TABLE kabipay_ops.organization_relationship ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY, organization_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES kabipay_ops.organization(id), organization_company_id UUID NOT NULL, source_tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, subject_employment_ref_id UUID NOT NULL, manager_employment_ref_id UUID NOT NULL, relationship_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CHECK(relationship_type IN ('PRIMARY','DOTTED_LINE','PROJECT','REVIEWER')), status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('PENDING','ACTIVE','ENDED')), effective_from TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, effective_to TIMESTAMPTZ, version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(version>0), graph_version BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK(graph_version>0), capabilities JSONB NOT NULL CHECK(jsonb_typeof(capabilities)='array'), installed_version BIGINT CHECK(installed_version>0), installed_hash CHAR(64), installed_configuration JSONB, created_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES kabipay_ops.principal(id), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), CONSTRAINT fk_org_relationship_company FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,organization_company_id,source_tenant_id) REFERENCES kabipay_ops.organization_company(organization_id,id,tenant_id), CONSTRAINT fk_org_relationship_subject FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,subject_employment_ref_id) REFERENCES kabipay_ops.employment_ref(organization_id,id), CONSTRAINT fk_org_relationship_manager FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,manager_employment_ref_id) REFERENCES kabipay_ops.employment_ref(organization_id,id), CHECK(subject_employment_ref_id<>manager_employment_ref_id), CHECK(effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to>effective_from) ); CREATE INDEX idx_org_relationship_subject ON kabipay_ops.organization_relationship(organization_id,subject_employment_ref_id,status); CREATE INDEX idx_org_relationship_manager ON kabipay_ops.organization_relationship(organization_id,manager_employment_ref_id,status); CREATE TABLE kabipay_ops.organization_command_intent ( membership_version BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK(membership_version>0), command_id UUID PRIMARY KEY, organization_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES kabipay_ops.organization(id), membership_id UUID NOT NULL, tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, principal_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES kabipay_ops.principal(id), source_tenant_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES kabipay_ops.tenant(id), source_user_id UUID NOT NULL, operation VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, resource_id UUID NOT NULL, expected_version BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK(expected_version>0), request_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL, authority_kind VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL CHECK(authority_kind IN ('organization_grant','management_assignment')), authority_id UUID NOT NULL, authority_version BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK(authority_version>0), employee_id UUID, status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'SUBMITTED' CHECK(status IN ('SUBMITTED','COMMITTED','AWAITING_CONFIRMATION','REJECTED','CANCELLED_NOT_EXECUTED')), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), CONSTRAINT fk_org_command_company FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,membership_id,tenant_id) REFERENCES kabipay_ops.organization_company(organization_id,id,tenant_id) ); CREATE INDEX idx_org_command_actor ON kabipay_ops.organization_command_intent(principal_id,created_at); ALTER TABLE kabipay_ops.role_binding_company ADD COLUMN installed_hash CHAR(64); CREATE TABLE kabipay_ops.organization_outbox_sequence ( aggregate_id UUID PRIMARY KEY, version BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK(version>0) );
